rule: Single source of truth for every image/clip prompt. Always keep the latest best version here; bump the item's version and add a line to prompts/CHANGELOG.md. Episode files are built from this by tools/build-shorts.mjs.

style.prefix: Claymation stop-motion style, handcrafted plasticine miniature diorama, warm clay textures with visible fingerprints and tool marks, soft warm studio lighting with gentle shadows, shallow depth of field, tilt-shift miniature feel, matte surfaces, muted earthy palette of terracotta, ochre, sandstone, indigo and leaf green,
style.suffix_9x16: , vertical 9:16 composition, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no modern objects unless stated
style.suffix_16x9: , cinematic 16:9 composition, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no modern objects unless stated
style.negative: photorealistic, real photograph, 3D CGI render, glossy plastic, anime, cartoon line art, chibi, cute baby proportions, text, letters, watermark, logo, extra fingers, extra limbs, distorted faces, gore, blood
style.sheet_style: Claymation stop-motion plasticine figure, handcrafted clay with visible fingerprints and tool marks, matte surfaces

BHEDIYA.name: भेड़िया (Bhediya), lead narrator and host of असली सीन
BHEDIYA.summary: a wise, adult anthropomorphic grey wolf storyteller who stands upright like a man
BHEDIYA.age_build: mature adult male wolf, stands upright on two legs, lean and strong, human-height impression, calm upright storyteller posture
BHEDIYA.eyes: deep amber-gold irises with fine darker flecks and a thin black rim, round dark pupils with one small warm catchlight each, heavy dark-grey brow ridges, the left brow ridge crossed by a thin pale healed scar
BHEDIYA.skin: clay-sculpted fur: silver-grey head and back with two charcoal streaks running from the forehead down between the eyes, cream-white muzzle, throat and chest, black leathery nose, the tip of the right ear slightly notched, fur strands pressed into the clay with visible tool marks
BHEDIYA.hair: thicker ruff of silver-grey fur around the neck and shoulders, ears upright and alert
BHEDIYA.expression: calm knowing half-smile with the mouth closed, right brow slightly raised, gaze direct and steady into the camera; wise and a little mischievous, never snarling, never showing fangs
BHEDIYA.outfit: a knee-length dark terracotta cotton kurta, plain and slightly worn at the hem; a weathered indigo cotton shawl draped over the left shoulder with a thin ochre border; a brown leather satchel strap across the chest; a small brass oil lantern hanging at the right hip; an old rolled parchment scroll held in the right paw; bare wolf feet, no shoes
BHEDIYA.notes: adult cinematic tone. Not cute, not cartoonish, no baby proportions. He appears in the brand intro, viewer-line scenes and the outro of every Short; story scenes show human figures.
BHEDIYA.scene_tag: BHEDIYA, the clay grey wolf storyteller standing upright (amber eyes, scar over left brow, indigo shawl with ochre border over a terracotta kurta, brass lantern at hip, rolled scroll in paw)

framing.vertical_rule: native 9:16; subject's face in the upper-middle third; keep faces and key action out of the top 12% and bottom 20% (platform buttons); stage in depth, not side by side

bhediya_shots._rule: Reusable narrator shots. Vary them: never use the same template twice in a row. Story lines show people; Bhediya appears on brand intro, cut-ins, viewer lines, comment ask and outro.

walk_in.prompt: {BHEDIYA} walking toward the camera down a narrow aisle of a lamp-lit stone archive, tall shelves of rolled scrolls on both sides rising to the top of frame, his brass lantern swinging gently at his hip, {extra}
walk_in.motion: Camera tracks slowly backward at his walking pace. He walks from mid-aisle toward the lens and stops in a medium shot, lifting his eyes to the viewer with a knowing half-smile. Lantern glow sways on the shelves. End on him standing still, facing camera.

scroll_reveal.prompt: {BHEDIYA} holding his old scroll open toward the camera, a small clay diorama of {topic_visual} rising out of the parchment between his paws, warm lantern light from below-left, archive shelves softly blurred behind
scroll_reveal.motion: Locked camera with a slow push-in. He unrolls the scroll; the tiny diorama rises out of it and settles. End with his eyes looking over the diorama straight into the lens.

cut_in_finger.prompt: {BHEDIYA} snapping his scroll shut in one paw and raising one clawed finger of the other paw beside his muzzle, one eyebrow raised, dark archive background with a single warm rim light
cut_in_finger.motion: Quick short push-in, then hold. He snaps the scroll shut and raises one finger. End frozen on the raised finger and raised brow.

lean_in_question.prompt: {BHEDIYA} leaning toward the camera, {pose}, {context_visual} softly blurred behind him, warm rim light
lean_in_question.motion: Locked camera. He leans in toward the lens, one ear twitches, the raised brow lifts. End with his face close, waiting for an answer.

point_at_viewer.prompt: {BHEDIYA} pointing one paw straight at the camera with a playful half-smile, lantern glow on his fur, {context_visual} in soft background
point_at_viewer.motion: Locked camera, very slight push-in. His paw comes up and points at the lens. End on the point, paw sharp, face just behind it.

touch_diorama.prompt: {BHEDIYA} crouching beside a tabletop clay diorama of {topic_visual}, reaching out with one paw to {touch_action}, lantern set down beside him
touch_diorama.motion: Slow descending crane toward his paw. He reaches out and {touch_action}. End with the paw resting on the diorama and his eyes lifting to the camera.

eye_ecu.prompt: extreme close-up of one deep amber-gold eye of {BHEDIYA} with the thin pale scar above the brow, flickering lantern light reflected in the iris, grey clay fur texture filling the frame
eye_ecu.motion: Slow push-in toward the eye. The pupil narrows slightly as the lantern flickers. End on the reflection in the iris.

map_tap_ots.prompt: over-the-shoulder view from behind {BHEDIYA} as he stands before a large clay relief map of India on the archive wall, {map_note}, his lantern raised in one paw
map_tap_ots.motion: Locked camera behind his shoulder. He reaches up and taps the glowing marker; it pulses brighter. End with his paw on the marker and his head turning halfway back toward camera.

walk_off.prompt: {BHEDIYA} seen from behind walking away from camera {where}, his lantern the only warm light, long shadow stretching toward the lens
walk_off.motion: Locked camera. He walks away into the dark, stops, and looks back over his shoulder at the viewer for a beat. End on the over-the-shoulder glance with the lantern glowing.
